required_fixes.method: independent-full-source-page-visual-comparison; PDF hashes checked independently; per-member constraints and outputs compared

ON/OFF/dont-care mapping and cover equivalence is shared, but 2000 Q34 asks which expression does NOT implement the map, 2007 Q9 tests variable independence, 2007 Q32 asks non-equivalence, 2024 Q47 includes maxterms and independence, and 2025 S2 Q43 asks multiple equivalent expressions. These do not all ask minimum SOP. Retain printed variable ordering, optional dont-cares and response polarity. Title and rationale need the correction below.

required_change.title: Derive and compare Boolean covers
required_change.rationale_update: Explicitly distinguish deriving a minimum SOP cover from using ON/OFF assignments to test equivalent formulas or variable independence; not every member requires minimization. Preserve all18 members.

required_fixes.method: independent-full-source-page-visual-comparison; PDF hashes checked independently; per-member constraints and outputs compared
required_fixes.independent_notes: All four ask universality of a component basis. The 1992,1993 and1999 printed sources do not explicitly supply constant inputs, while those constants change completeness of mux/half-adder/AND-XOR bases. Existing per-ID caveats correctly retain this. The title must say constant assumptions, not imply source-explicit constants. 2015 singleton f/g requires preservation or constructive completeness reasoning without silently free constants.

required_change.title: Test functional completeness with constant assumptions
required_change.rationale_update: Keep explicit that fixed constants are not specified in some historical sources. Existing per-ID caveats must remain; do not assert unique unconditional answers across constant conventions. Preserve all4 members.
